subject.title: ci(release): migrate Telecrawl to shared pipeline

question: Should Telecrawl adopt the shared release pipeline before an equivalent pre-publication byte-identical Linux/Windows rebuild-verification hook is available?
rationale: The PR expressly defers a former release-assurance guarantee, which is a release-policy choice rather than a mechanical code correction.

options.title: Require equivalent shared proof
options.body: Keep the existing assurance as a required publication gate until the shared pipeline supplies an equivalent pre-publication hook.

options.title: Accept the deferred guarantee
options.body: Adopt the shared pipeline now and accept that the legacy verifier remains a manual historical-release check.

recommendation.title: Require equivalent shared proof
recommendation.body: Keep the existing assurance as a required publication gate until the shared pipeline supplies an equivalent pre-publication hook.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context identifies steipete as the author of this release migration; current-main ownership evidence was unavailable.
